business_problem: Mercedes-Benz needed to move AI-powered automation from isolated pilot projects into secure, governed day-to-day business processes across functions including development, production, sales, financial services, human resources, and technology.
solution_summary: Mercedes-Benz is rolling out a global AI automation platform built around n8n to let employees create AI-powered workflows and connect them directly to operational processes. In the described operating model, employees and specialist teams generate use cases through a company-wide hackathon and then implement the strongest ones on a shared foundation with governance guardrails and responsible AI standards. n8n serves as the orchestration layer that connects existing internal systems, coordinates automation logic, and supports newer AI-agent patterns alongside established workflow automation. The deployment is self-hosted and cloud-agnostic, which Mercedes-Benz says helps it retain control over critical data and workflows. The page does not name separate model, storage, or database products; instead, it emphasizes a modular architecture in which workflow execution, data handling, and process integration remain inside a secure, governance-compliant Mercedes-Benz environment.

solution_components.name: n8n
solution_components.role: n8n is the global workflow platform Mercedes-Benz uses to build, orchestrate, and integrate AI-powered workflows across existing business systems.

business_outcome: Mercedes-Benz is scaling AI automation from hackathon and pilot ideas into governed production workflows, with the stated goal of making processes faster, more transparent, more effective, and easier to scale across the company.
